summary: All FIVE r2 blockers are genuinely applied in the BODY (not just the changelog) and are internally consistent: (C-1new f32) — §3.4 line 161 + §3.5 line 226 + §10 line 348 make the ENTIRE float pipeline AND the host re-check f32-only; every remaining `f64` token (lines 111/161/167/226/293/348/384) is an EXPLICIT PROHIBITION, no stale f64 sampling/re-check survives; open-lower-at-0 → f32::MIN_POSITIVE (FTZ-safe), general open bound → f32::next_up/next_down; host re-check evaluates the std430-DECODED f32 bytes actually sent, so a boundary f32-vs-f64 divergence can no longer be false-branded precondition_check_miscompiled. (C-2new deferred exemption) — §3.2(b) line 112 attributes each fired flag_words[0] bit via the real DebugCheck.bit field (confirmed present, §1(2) line 16 struct list) and exempts deferred/unconstrained conditions to UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED, folded into §3.5/§3.6/§10/AT-2892. (AT-2893) exit 1 → exit 3, now consistent EVERYWHERE (grep: UNSAT=3 at 230/237/295/345, no stale exit-1-for-UNSAT anywhere). (fix-4 totality) the 4-quadrant table with the 4th quadrant satisfier_unsound_or_check_inert (ERROR 2) appears identically in §3.2(b), the r3-changelog table (388-396), §10 line 347, and AT-2891. (AT-2897) proven-firing (seed,scalar_window,runs) triple PINNED at implementation time, deterministic not probabilistic. The exit-code map is airtight and collision-free (0/1/2/3). ONE blocker remains, and it is exactly the pair of questions the r3 review was told to check (task-2 constrained-vs-deferred precedence, task-3 leg-(a)/(b) masking): the spec NEVER states the run/session verdict PRECEDENCE between the SKIPPED-class exit-0 UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED and the FAIL/ERROR outcomes. grep for precedence/severity/aggregate/'any run'/most-severe finds ONLY line 345 (UNSAT-vs-GPU-probe) and line 228 (PASS-requires-all-clean) — nothing ordering the non-PASS outcomes. The local sentence at line 112 ('the verdict is UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED' upon a deferred fire) admits an early-return implementation that reports exit 0 while a real bug in the SAME run — a leg-(a) device_fault, a leg-(b) postcondition_violation, or a constrained-subset precondition_check_miscompiled(FAIL)/satisfier_unsound_or_check_inert(ERROR) — is masked. That is a false-GREEN at the CI exit-code level, the milestone's own stated worst failure mode ('a fuzzer that lies is worse than none'). Reachable on a plausible kernel with BOTH a deferred relational precondition AND a postcondition/constrained precondition (no SHIPPED fixture triggers it, so no AT catches it — identical to why I made r2/C-2new critical: the RULE ships unsound). One-clause fix. Architecture, scope, AT-range (2881..2899) all STAND. NEEDS_REVISION, not REJECT.
critical_issues: CRITICAL C-3new (verdict PRECEDENCE is undefined — the exit-0 UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED can MASK a real FAIL/ERROR in the same run/session ⇒ false-green at the CI exit-code level). This is the r3 review's own task-2 and task-3 check, and it FAILS both. TASK-2 (BOTH a deferred bit AND a constrained bit fired in one run — which wins?): §3.2(b) line 112 says 'If the fired bit belongs to a condition the satisfier did not constrain ..., the verdict is UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED' — an UNCONDITIONAL assignment. The follow-on ('removes from the quadrant classification; the quadrant table applies ONLY to the constrained subset') IMPLIES the constrained subset is still classified, but the spec NEVER states which of the two resulting run verdicts wins. A Coder implementing line 112 literally as an early-return on the first deferred-attributed bit would report UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED (exit 0) and SKIP the constrained-subset quadrant classification entirely, masking a precondition_check_miscompiled (FAIL, exit 1) or a satisfier_unsound_or_check_inert (ERROR, exit 2) on the SAME run. TASK-3 (does exit-0 mask a leg-(a) fault or leg-(b) postcondition violation?): §3.5 line 228 defines PASS strictly (all legs (a)+(b)+(c) clear + top-left quadrant every run), and §3.5 line 229 lists FAIL as 'a counterexample was found: postcondition violation / device fault / ...', but NOWHERE is it stated that a leg-(a)/(b)/(c) FAIL or an ERROR OUTRANKS the SKIPPED-class UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED. Since BOTH UNCONSTRAINED and FAIL are non-PASS session verdicts and UNCONSTRAINED maps to exit 0 (the CI success code), a run/session that BOTH fires a deferred relational pre-bit (expected) AND device-faults or violates a postcondition (a real found bug — the fuzzer's PRODUCT) has an UNDEFINED verdict; an implementation that resolves the deferred exemption first returns exit 0 and buries the real bug. grep confirms NO ordering language exists (precedence appears only at line 345 for UNSAT-vs-GPU-probe; 'any run/all runs' only at line 228 for PASS). FIX (spec-text, one clause): state an explicit run-level AND session-level SEVERITY ORDERING — ERROR (compile_failed, satisfier_unsound, satisfier_unsound_or_check_inert) > FAIL (device_fault, postcondition_violation, nondeterministic, precondition_check_did_not_fire, precondition_check_miscompiled) > UNSATISFIABLE > UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED (SKIPPED-class) > SKIPPED > PASS — such that legs (a)/(b)/(c) and the CONSTRAINED-subset quadrant outcome are ALWAYS evaluated and take precedence, and UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED is emitted (with its note) ONLY WHEN, after removing the deferred bits, the constrained subset is clean AND legs (a)/(b)/(c) all passed on that run. Explicitly: the deferred-exemption note is still emitted, but a coexisting leg-(a)/(b) FAIL or constrained FAIL/ERROR WINS. Without this, the exemption re-introduces the exact false-report the whole discriminator design exists to prevent — just as a silent exit-0 instead of a false exit-1.
warnings: MINOR W-4new (add a pin so C-3new cannot regress). No shipped fixture has BOTH a deferred relational precondition AND a postcondition/constrained precondition, so no AT exercises the masking scenario — the precedence rule would ship UNTESTED (the same gap I flagged for r2/C-2new). RECOMMEND a discriminator UNIT (no GPU needed, folds into AT-2892's synthetic-feed harness): feed the orchestrator a synthetic run carrying BOTH a deferred-attributed fired bit AND (a) a constrained host-SAT+GPU-fired signal, then (b) a leg-(b) postcondition-violation signal, and assert the run verdict is FAIL (exit 1) in BOTH cases — NOT UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED — with the deferred note STILL present. This pins the severity ordering against a future Coder early-return.

MINOR W-5new (next_up/next_down bit-fallback sign handling — flagged, not fully specified). Line 167 offers 'f32::from_bits(x.to_bits() ± 1) with sign handling' as the pre-1.86 fallback for f32::next_up/next_down. For NEGATIVE floats the naive to_bits()+1 moves TOWARD zero (wrong direction for next_up), so the sign handling is load-bearing. It is only a fallback (Rust 1.86+ std next_up/next_down are correct and preferred) and the shipped open-bound case is open-lower-AT-0 → f32::MIN_POSITIVE (never hits the negative branch), so this is non-blocking — but state 'prefer std f32::next_up/next_down; the bit-fallback must special-case sign (negative: to_bits()-1 for next_up)' so a Coder on an older toolchain does not silently step the wrong way.
vendor_concerns: FTZ resolved (r2 vendor concern closed): the open-lower-at-0 floor is now f32::MIN_POSITIVE (smallest NORMAL, 1.18e-38) per §3.4 line 166 + r3-changelog line 384 — survives flush-to-zero on NVIDIA/AMD as well as Lavapipe, so the AT-2896 satisfier-soundness invariant (flag_words[0]==0 across the sweep) cannot be poisoned by a subnormal being flushed to 0.0. The C-1new host-re-check-on-std430-decoded-f32-bytes makes host and GPU evaluate the identical bit pattern, closing the cross-vendor false-miscompile risk.

No hardcoded subgroup/wave assumptions in the fuzzer; AT-2899 violate leg on precondition_saxpy (non-coopmat/non-shared, alpha-pinned) runs on Lavapipe without NVIDIA — cross-vendor discipline retained.

verdict_rationale: NEEDS_REVISION on the FINAL cycle, escalating to the orchestrator with an exact one-clause fix. Every one of the five r2 blockers (f32 precision, deferred exemption, AT-2893 exit 3, 4-quadrant totality, AT-2897 seed pin) is genuinely and correctly resolved in the body, internally consistent, and re-verified against the exit-code and f64-prohibition greps. But the r3 review's own task-2/task-3 precedence check FAILS: the spec never orders the SKIPPED-class exit-0 UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED against the FAIL/ERROR outcomes, and the literal §3.2(b) line-112 assignment ('the verdict is UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED') admits an early-return that reports exit 0 while a leg-(a) device fault, a leg-(b) postcondition violation, or a constrained-subset miscompile/unsound in the SAME run is masked — a false-green at the CI exit-code level, the milestone's own worst failure mode, reachable on a multi-precondition kernel and untested by any shipped AT (exactly the RULE-ships-unsound reasoning that made r2/C-2new critical). The fix is one severity-ordering sentence + one composition unit; no redesign, no scope or AT-range change. If the orchestrator applies the ordering clause (ERROR > FAIL > UNSATISFIABLE > UNCONSTRAINED_PRECONDITION_FIRED > SKIPPED > PASS, legs and constrained-subset take precedence, deferred note still emitted) the milestone closes.
